balloon_amount.description:
Balloon amount repaid with the instalment, in currency units; present in the last row
only.

instalment.description:
Amount paid, interest plus principal portion (balloon amount included in the last row),
in currency units.

interest_portion.description:
Periodic rate × outstanding balance at the start of the period, in currency units; not
rounded.

outstanding_balance.description: Outstanding balance after the instalment, in currency units.

period.description: Period number (a count of payment periods), from 1 to n.

principal_portion.description:
Principal repaid in the period (balloon amount included in the last row), in currency
units.

time.description: Payment time of the instalment, in periods from the start (time k for period k).

instalments.description: Sum of the instalments, in currency units.

interest.description: Sum of the interest portions, in currency units.

principal.description: Sum of the principal portions (equal to the principal), in currency units.

final_adjustment.description:
Last instalment less the balloon amount less the regular instalment of the last period:
the correction that brings the outstanding balance exactly to zero, in currency units.

periodic_rate.description: Rate per payment period used, decimal fraction.

rows.description: One row per period, amounts in currency units.

totals.description: Totals of instalments, interest and principal, in currency units.
